name: PanVK Kbase — RC5-universal-114
displayVersion: RC5-universal-114 (Mesa 5a07217f, csf-v11 018-232 + jm-v9 + jm-v7 + jm-v7-wip 0006-0092; v6/v7/v9/v10/v11 in one .so)
author: abhay-byte
description: Experimental PanVK driver for Mali GPUs on mali_kbase: Bifrost JM v6/v7, Valhall JM v9 and CSF v10-v14 in one .so. RC5-universal-114 fixes the RC5-universal-113 sparse device TLS on CSF (every job now uses the stack stride the TLS was built for, so threads no longer share stacks), keeping the 113 memory savings. Bundled in this APK.
